i.remote.cert.android: Android: Settings › Security › Encryption and credentials › Install a certificate › CA certificate › «Install anyway» › choose PozzoLauncher-CA.crt.
i.remote.cert.haveIt: I've already installed the certificate on the phone (hide the QR code)
i.remote.cert.install: Install the certificate on the phone
i.remote.cert.intro: With a «self-signed» certificate the phone shows connection not private and the browser refuses to install the app. Installing this PC's CA instead makes the warning go away, the app installs and works even without a network.
i.remote.cert.ios: iPhone/iPad: Settings › General › VPN & Device Management › install the profile; then Settings › General › About › Certificate Trust Settings › turn on «Pozzo Launcher CA».
i.remote.cert.noteA: If the PC changes IP address, the server certificate is regenerated automatically, but the CA stays the same: nothing needs reinstalling. The ca.key key stays in the certs folder on the PC.
i.remote.cert.noteB1: If the phone can't download it (download blocked by the security warning), save it on the PC with
i.remote.cert.noteB2: and transfer it to the phone by cable, email or cloud.
i.remote.cert.s1: Scan the QR code (or open {url}) and accept the warning Advanced › Proceed: this is the last time it appears.
i.remote.cert.s4: Close and reopen the page: no warning, and ⬇ Install appears at the top (on iPhone/iPad: Share › Add to Home Screen).
i.remote.cert.title: PC certificate (one time only)

i.remote.dsu.aim: For games without a gyroscope, in the phone app choose 🎯 Aim: tilting the phone moves the right stick.
i.remote.dsu.cemu: Options › Input settings › controller tab › Motion: «DSU» (cemuhook), 127.0.0.1:26760.
i.remote.dsu.dolphin: Controllers › Alternative input sources › DSU Client: enable, 127.0.0.1:26760; then on the Wii Remote choose the DSUClient device.
i.remote.dsu.ok: Gyroscope for emulators: DSU server active on 127.0.0.1:26760
i.remote.dsu.ryujinx: Options › Settings › Input › Configure › Motion: «CemuHook compatible», server 127.0.0.1, port 26760, player slot.
i.remote.dsu.summary: How to enable the gyroscope in emulators
i.remote.emu.dolphin: Configure Dolphin for the Wii Remote
i.remote.emu.note: Writes the emulator settings (close the emulator first) and makes a copy next to the original. Buzz!: USB port 1 = Buzz Controller, phone N = player N. Guitar: ports 1..N become guitars. Dolphin: Wii Remote 1..N = phone 1..N, with Nunchuk, buttons and motion from the DSU server.
